name: workspace-resize-dock
summary: Draggable pane sizes and a dockable terminal
body:
Every seam is now a splitter with pointer-captured dragging and
persisted sizes (sidebar, stage column, commit list, stack and
inspector columns, terminal): a small usePaneSize hook over a
storage wrapper with an in-memory fallback, unit-tested. The
terminal docks at the bottom or the right of the workspace and the
choice persists; a pty failure now shows the actual error with a
retry button instead of flash-closing the drawer; the statusbar's
empty area drags the window.
